subject: Cross-region demo — schedule conflict with JP Golden Week and UK bank holiday
messages:

To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: maya.iyer@finx.co.uk
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 03:15:00 +0900
Subject: Request: product demo for FinX — proposed 2 May slot

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the intro — FinX (Maya and team copied) is excited to see the Redwood Inference platform. Would you be able to run a live demo on Tuesday, 2 May at 09:00 JST?

A few notes on our side: several engineers in Tokyo will be online that morning and we can get a 60–75 minute slot. Maya in London is flexible but prefers afternoon UK time. If 2 May is tight for you, please propose alternatives. Also please include any pre-reads if helpful.

Regards,
Satoshi
Head of Integrations, CloudBridge
S: +81 80 1234 5678

--
Attachments: none
From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 08:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: product demo for FinX — proposed 2 May slot

Heads up — Satoshi asked for 2 May at 09:00 JST. That exact date conflicts with region-specific OOO patterns. Quick summary: 

- Japan: Golden Week follow-up / local observances mean many customers mark early May as reduced coverage (even if not full official GW dates).
- UK: early-May bank holiday (first Mon/Tue in some years) can push UK attendees to take nearby days off.
- DST: calendar conversions this week + attendee calendar clients sometimes misapply DST offsets — we should use explicit UTC times in invites.

Proposed plan (short):
1) Offer two live-session windows to cover EU + APAC attendance and reduce cross-region fatigue:
   - Option A: 2027-05-06 13:00 UTC (good for EU afternoon, APAC late evening)
   - Option B: 2027-05-07 01:00 UTC (early APAC morning, late US evening)
2) If a single session is required, record and provide short highlights for JP/India attendees who are OOO.
3) Include Neha (security/arch) and Jonas (runtime lead) in the invite as optional for technical Q&A.

Action items:
- Aditya: confirm presenter availability for those alternate windows.
- Neha/Jonas: quick thumbs up on availability and whether you want to join live or recorded.

I'll draft a reply to Satoshi with two concrete UTC options and attach a short slots CSV + runbook.

Best,
Laura
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 09:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: product demo for FinX — proposed 2 May slot

Thanks Laura — I can present (overview + business Qs). Jonas has a short blackout on 3–4 May but is OK for 6–7 May. Neha, can you join for the security section? If not, we can record and do a follow-up deep-dive.

Quick timezone conversions (for reference):
- Option A: 2027-05-06 13:00 UTC = 22:00 JST / 14:00 BST / 09:00 PT
- Option B: 2027-05-07 01:00 UTC = 10:00 JST (next day) / 02:00 BST / 18:00 PT

Note: double-check personal calendars — some clients (Outlook on mobile) will show local offsets differently around bank holidays. I'll include explicit UTC in the calendar invite and the body of the email.

Fallback: record the session and post a ~10-minute highlights clip and transcript for JP attendees.

- Aditya
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
To: Satoshi Yamada <satoshi.yamada@cloudbridge.jp>, Maya Iyer <maya.iyer@finx.co.uk>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 14:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: product demo for FinX — proposed 2 May slot

Hi Satoshi and Maya — thanks for the quick reply.

We'd like to avoid 2 May to ensure full engagement across regions. Can you confirm which of the two options below works better for FinX? We will send calendar invites with explicit UTC and attach a recording if needed.

Options (explicit UTC):
- Option A: Thursday, 2027-05-06 — 13:00 UTC (approx 22:00 JST / 14:00 BST) — 60 minutes + Q&A
- Option B: Friday, 2027-05-07 — 01:00 UTC (approx 10:00 JST on 7 May / 02:00 BST) — 60 minutes + Q&A

Attachments: proposed_slots.csv (CSV of the two options in multiple timezones), demo-runbook.pdf (outline and tech checklist). Please review the runbook for the proposed flow and let us know if you'd like a shorter 30-minute exec-only version.

We will also include Neha (security) and Jonas (runtime) as optional shooters to handle any deep technical questions. If some Japanese participants will be OOO, we will make sure to record and provide a short highlights clip + a transcript.

Next steps: reply with "A" or "B" and I'll send the official invite (UTC times included).

Best regards,
Laura Bennett
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (650) 555-0199

--

Hi Laura / Satoshi — Option A (2027-05-06 13:00 UTC) works best for the FinX team. We prefer that time so more of our London-based stakeholders can join live.

A couple quick asks:
- Please include a short recording for any JP attendees who may be on reduced hours during Golden Week follow-up.
- Can Neha include a 10-minute security checklist at the end? If Neha is not available live, a pre-recorded security highlight is fine.
- We will need the calendar invite with explicit UTC times and an ICS we can distribute internally.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Maya Iyer
Head of Product, FinX
